LESSON: HUMAN SEXUALITY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.2: Human Sexuality

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Human Sexuality. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Human Sexuality
2. Practise Human Sexuality at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Human Sexuality

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Human Sexuality
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Human Sexuality. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Human Sexuality at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Human Sexuality at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Human Sexuality
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Human Sexuality. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Human Sexuality using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Human Sexuality in the examples.
2. Explain Human Sexuality to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Human Sexuality.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Human Sexuality using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Human Sexuality important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Human Sexuality
2. Practise Human Sexuality at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Human Sexuality

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
